profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (iOS)
profile.summary: I'm a senior iOS engineer with 12+ years experience at some of tech's most innovative companies. I build tools and processes that scale across engineering orgs, lead cross-platform initiatives end-to-end, and mentor ICs toward promotion. My work spans AI-focused development, cross-platform infrastructure, stability and performance, and consumer-scale product engineering.
